introHtml: Cotton poly sportswear combines the softness of cotton with the durability and moisture-wicking properties of polyester. This blend resists shrinking and wrinkles, making it a reliable choice for uniforms, team apparel, and event giveaways. Whether you need polo shirts for a company picnic or performance tees for a charity 5K, cotton poly fabrics hold up to frequent washing while keeping your logo looking crisp. Decorate with screen printing or embroidery for a professional finish.
